lean.statement: ∀ {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] {V : E → ℝ} {α : ℝ}, ContDiff ℝ 2 V → (∀ x v : E, α * ‖v‖ ^ 2 ≤ (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x v) v) → StrongConvexOn (Set.univ : Set E) α V
approved_definition_context: E is any real normed vector space. No completeness, finite-dimensionality, inner-product, measurable-space or measure assumption is imposed. The scalar α is an arbitrary real number.
ContDiff ℝ 2 V means that the real-valued function V is genuinely twice continuously Fréchet differentiable everywhere.

fderiv ℝ V x is the continuous linear Fréchet derivative when V is differentiable at x, and is totalized to zero otherwise. fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x is the derivative of the continuous-linear-map-valued first derivative. Applying this second derivative to v and then v gives the diagonal evaluation D²V(x)[v,v]. The C² assumption supplies genuine first and second derivatives here.

StrongConvexOn s α V means that s is convex and V(a • x + b • y) ≤ a * V(x) + b * V(y) - (α / 2) * a * b * ‖x-y‖^2 for every x,y∈s and all real a,b≥0 with a+b=1. Here s=Set.univ is the whole space and • is real scalar multiplication.
